content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: THSTI Recruitment 2026 covers posts under five projects. The table summarises the official notification details. Register for Job Alerts THSTI is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council and conducts translational research that turns concepts into products to improve human health. Its centres include the Centre for Maternal and Child Health, Centre for Virus Research, Therapeutics and Vaccines, Centre for Tuberculosis Research, Centre for Microbial Research, Centre for Immunobiology and Immunotherapy, Centre for Drug Discovery, Clinical Development Services Agency, Computational and Mathematical Biology Centre, and Centre for Bio-design and Diagnostics.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Posts: Desirable Skills, Duties and Posting Location
content_sections.text: The details below are taken from the notification’s job description and skills columns. Posting: Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi. Desirable: Experience in clinical/health research project. Registered with RCI. Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Office applications. Effective communication skills to provide timely and accurate information to participants and their caregivers. Responsibilities: Application, interpretation and recording of GSED assessment of infant. Application, interpretation and recording of Bayley’s scale IV of infant development. Application, interpretation and recording of HINE. Application, interpretation and recording of INCLEN Diagnostic Tool for Autism Spectrum Disorder (INDT-ASD). Application, interpretation and recording of INCLEN Diagnostic Tool for Epilepsy (INCLEN-INDT-EPI). Training and monitoring of Psychologist, Project Nurse, Field Worker in the study. Counselling of mothers with health concerns. Essential package of care for baby with cognitive/social delays (counselling of parents in early intervention). Any other work as assigned by PI. Posting: Civil Hospital, Sector 10, Gurgaon, Haryana. Desirable: Experience in performing HINE assessments for infants between 0-2 years. Experience in working with pediatrics age groups. Registered with a recognized council of occupational therapy and physiotherapy (COTPT). Good communication skills both in Hindi and English. Responsibilities: Assessment of infants and children in a clinical research cohort at a district hospital. Perform Hammersmith Infant Neurological Examination (HINE) and Hammersmith Neonatal Neurological Examination (HNNE) and assess infants and children in the cohort. Perform electronic data collection in terms of assessment points and scores. Provide inputs into study related materials such as clinical operations plan, SOPs, CRFs, guideline and training module. Assist the clinical Research coordinator (CRC) and site investigator for study related activities and work assigned by the PI. Posting: The selected candidate may be required to work at the Gurugram Civil Hospital, depending on project requirements. Desirable qualifications are not specified in the notification. Responsibilities: Collection and processing of infant/clinical biospecimens. Scanning, barcoding, and storage of processed biospecimens using laboratory management software and digital platforms. Sorting, retrieval, packing, and shipment of biospecimens to laboratories in accordance with IATA guidelines. Molecular biology techniques, including nucleic acid isolation from blood samples and DNA concentration estimation. Maintaining accurate documentation and records related to receipt, processing, storage, retrieval, and shipment of biospecimens at the Biorepository. Supporting day-to-day biorepository activities and ensuring compliance with established SOPs and quality requirements. Posting location is not specified; the walk-in is at THSTI, Faridabad. content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 General Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: These are short-term positions. Extension will be granted subject to satisfactory performance of the incumbents and the tenure of the project. Those appointed will have no claim for regularization of employment. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University. The experience requirement is the experience acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications. Candidates must satisfy themselves about eligibility before applying/appearing. No query will be entertained regarding eligibility criteria. The date of interview of the respective post is the crucial date for determining eligibility with regard to age, experience, essential qualification etc. Age and other relaxations are as listed in the age relaxation section above. All results/notifications will only be published on the THSTI website, so candidates should visit it regularly. All communications will only be made through email. If many candidates appear for the walk-in interview, screening will be done to limit the number of candidates to those possessing higher/relevant qualification and experience. The number of vacancies may change subject to actual requirement at the time of the written test/skill test/interview. For any provisions not covered in the notification, the bye laws of THSTI/Govt. of India rules/guidelines will prevail. Canvassing wrong information in any form will be a disqualification. The notification adds that the Government strives to have a work force which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply. It is signed by the Head-Administration.

faq.question: Q1. What is the full form of THSTI?
faq.answer: THSTI stands for Translational Health Science and Technology Institute, which is an autonomous institute of the Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of selection for THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for various project positions at THSTI is carried out through a written test, skill test, and personal interview conducted during the walk-in drive.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies have been announced under advertisement number THS/RN/20/2026 for various project posts including Senior Psychologist, Occupational Therapist, and Research Scientists.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for the Senior Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Research Scientist-II (Senior Psychologist) position is scheduled to be held on 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is generally set up to 50 years depending on the specific post, with permissible age relaxations applicable for reserved categories like SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview sessions for these project-based positions.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is required for the Senior Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post-Graduate degree in Psychology or Clinical Psychology or relevant subjects from a recognized university along with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their updated CV, original educational and experience documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of all certificates, a valid photo ID card, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for the Research Scientist position?
faq.answer: The Research Scientist position offers a consolidated salary of up to Rs. 1,50,000/- per month, while other posts range between Rs. 28,000/- and Rs. 75,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification details and updates?
faq.answer: You can check the official notification details, venue details, and further updates by visiting the official website of THSTI at www.thsti.res.in.
